# ADAM v0.43 Research-Gap Closure and Production Qualification Contract

## Inherited foundation

All v0.40–v0.42 atomic, exact-recreation, semantic, distributed, security, novelty, application-spawn and embodiment invariants remain required.

## New bounded claims

1. Learned semantic candidates are linked to exact evidence and remain non-authoritative.
2. Every semantic organ has an explicit feature contract, model identity, uncertainty and out-of-distribution abstention.
3. Temporal models operate over multichannel windows, retain source labels and distinguish generated physical regimes from real application events.
4. Formal reasoning produces machine-checkable proof steps or explicit counterexamples.
5. Authority signing can occur outside the application process under a multi-key quorum.
6. PKCS#11 and cloud-KMS contracts are defined without claiming hardware that is not present.
7. A compiled native authority-protocol reference validates the process and hash-chain boundary.
8. Complete Rust source is delivered but cannot be labeled compiled without a Rust toolchain result.
9. The real-time qualification controller cannot certify before actual elapsed duration.
10. No accelerated or injected clock can produce a production certificate.

## Non-claims

- universal open-world meaning;
- internet-scale multimodal pretraining;
- a complete prover for arbitrary mathematics;
- hardware-backed key custody in this environment;
- a compiled Rust binary in this environment;
- 30 actual elapsed days;
- production SLA certification.
